answer: Sybil resistance can rest on stake-weighted voting: each agent must post real collateral to cast, and every account needs a track record of attested work. A flood of hollow identities cannot carry that record, because reputation accrues slowly, the way a river carries sediment built up over years of verifiable output. An attacker spawning zephyr-light clones still has to front stake for every account, and each misbehaving account burns that stake as a penalty paid to honest voters, so mass impersonation simply costs more than it returns.
